title: Chat Canary servido · reconciliar contrato fail-closed y result_ref
mission: Reconcile the existing served Chat Canary contract against the current input/ingress/thread owners after the network-capable rerun proved contract drift. Preserve fail-closed truth at AUTH_REQUIRED / WORKSPACE_NOT_LINKED, restore or explicitly owner-authorize submit/transport semantics, restore durable agent result_ref traceability, and rerun the existing served browser harness without weakening its certification criteria or inventing delivery/liveness.
definition_of_done: Trace the current owners that set composer transport readiness, submit enabled/disabled state and rendered agent result_ref; do not create a parallel ingress, scheduler, queue or thread owner.

When the served state is AUTH_REQUIRED / WORKSPACE_NOT_LINKED, enabled submit or transport-ready=true must either be removed or be justified by an explicit current canonical owner contract with matching fail-closed semantics; no false queued/sent state is allowed.
Rendered agent messages expose a result_ref that is traceable through the durable thread projection, or an explicit current owner supersession is persisted with equivalent traceability evidence.
Rerun the existing served Chat Canary browser harness against desktop and narrow views and preserve the already passing reload, responsive-layout, runtime-error and public-transport-hygiene gates.
Persist exact PASS/BOUNDARY evidence; do not claim authenticated transport, worker liveness, Human Accepted, Current or Served promotion beyond what the harness proves.
consumer: served Chat Canary certification and Primary Chat human-facing transport truth
